gates.name: CI Green
gates.description: All continuous integration checks on main must pass with zero failures, including TypeScript compilation, Python linting, schema validation, contract validation, CodeQL security scanning, and rc:verify workflow.
gates.verificationMethod: Check GitHub Actions status on main branch for the target RC commit. All jobs must be green.

gates.name: Release Notes
gates.description: A release notes document must exist at docs/releases/<version>.md covering all changes, known limitations, upgrade path, and security considerations.
gates.verificationMethod: Verify docs/releases/<version>.md exists and contains Added, Changed, Fixed, and Security sections.

gates.name: CHANGELOG Entry
gates.description: CHANGELOG.md must include a dated entry for the version being promoted.
gates.verificationMethod: Verify CHANGELOG.md contains a section for the target version.

gates.name: Release Artifacts
gates.description: Release manifest, artifact digests (SHA3-512 primary, SHA-256 secondary), and verification summary must be generated and published under release/artifacts/<version>/.
gates.verificationMethod: Verify release/artifacts/<version>/ contains release-manifest.json, artifact-digests.json, and verification-summary.json.

gates.name: Supply Chain Baseline
gates.description: A CycloneDX 1.5 JSON SBOM and in-toto Statement v1 with SLSA v1 predicate must exist for the release.
gates.verificationMethod: Verify release/artifacts/<version>/ contains sbom.cyclonedx.json and provenance.intoto.json.

gates.name: Self-Hosted Validation
gates.description: A self-hosted quickstart guide must exist and the RC smoke test script must pass against a running instance on PORT=9100.
gates.verificationMethod: Run scripts/smoke/self-hosted-rc-smoke.sh against a running instance and verify zero failures.

gates.name: Governance Enforcement
gates.description: All seven canonical enforcement flags must be present and operational: auditEnforcementEnabled, knowledgeTraceEnforcementEnabled, dreamSafetyEnforcementEnabled, auditEnforcementMiddleware, knowledgeTraceEnforcementMiddleware, dreamSafetyEnforcementMiddleware, policyRuntimeEnforcement.
gates.verificationMethod: Run pnpm rc:verify and confirm the governance category reports all 7 flags present.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.description: Release artifacts must be reproducible. Running pnpm release:artifacts on the same commit must produce bit-identical digest outputs.
gates.verificationMethod: Run pnpm release:artifacts twice on the same commit and diff the artifact-digests.json outputs.

gates.name: No Regressions
gates.description: No regressions in test coverage, API contracts, or enforcement behavior compared to the previous release. Any behavioral change must be documented.
gates.verificationMethod: Compare test results, contract schemas, and enforcement behavior against the previous release baseline.

gates.name: Cryptographic Signing
gates.description: Release provenance must be cryptographically signed. Unsigned provenance is classified as signing-not-configured.
gates.verificationMethod: Verify provenance.intoto.json contains a valid signature from a configured signing key.

gates.name: Infrastructure Validation
gates.description: External infrastructure services (Terraform Cloud, GCP, Cloudflare, Kubernetes) must be validated when available. Missing infrastructure is classified as infrastructure-not-configured.
gates.verificationMethod: Run rc:verify and confirm infrastructure-not-configured items are documented in the verification summary.

infrastructureNotConfigured.description: Infrastructure checks that cannot run due to missing external services (Terraform Cloud, GCP, Cloudflare, Kubernetes).
infrastructureNotConfigured.rcPolicy: Acceptable if documented in verification summary and release notes. Must be tracked for resolution.
infrastructureNotConfigured.stablePolicy: Must be resolved through proper secret configuration or formally accepted as out-of-scope with documented justification.

signingNotConfigured.description: Release provenance that lacks cryptographic signing.
signingNotConfigured.rcPolicy: Acceptable. Provenance is generated but classified as signing-not-configured.
signingNotConfigured.stablePolicy: Must be resolved. A signing key must be configured and all provenance statements must include valid signatures.

steps.description: Confirm all required gates pass on the target RC tag
Execute pnpm rc:verify and confirm all check categories pass with documented infrastructure skips
Run pnpm release:artifacts && pnpm release:sbom && pnpm release:provenance
Execute scripts/smoke/self-hosted-rc-smoke.sh against a self-hosted instance
File a GitHub issue or PR referencing the RC tag, CI status, verification summary, artifact digests, SBOM, and provenance
At least one platform maintainer must approve the promotion
Push the stable tag and create a GitHub release with notes and artifact links

exceptions.process: File a GitHub issue documenting the criterion that cannot be met, the reason, risk assessment, and mitigation plan. Obtain approval from two platform maintainers.
exceptions.scopeLimitation: Exceptions are valid for a single release only and must be re-evaluated for subsequent releases.
